# DN cases for scripts/capture-dn.sh to put through slapd's
# own dnNormalize and dnPretty. One per line; # is a comment.
#
# The point is to cover what RFC 4514 leaves room to get wrong,
# not to be tidy: case folding, spacing, escapes, hex forms,
# multi-valued RDNs, and attributes with different matching
# rules.

# Plain
dc=example,dc=com
cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com

# Case: attribute descriptions and caseIgnoreMatch values
CN=Foo Bar,DC=Example,DC=COM
cn=FOO BAR,dc=example,dc=com

# Spacing around separators and within values
cn=Foo Bar,  dc=example,  dc=com
CN=  spaced  ,DC=y
cn=a  b,dc=x

# Escapes: RFC 4514 2.4
cn=a\, b,dc=x
cn=a\,b,dc=x
cn=a\+b,dc=x
cn=a\=b,dc=x
cn=a\\b,dc=x
cn=a\"b,dc=x
cn=a\<b,dc=x
cn=a\>b,dc=x
cn=a\;b,dc=x
cn=\#hash,dc=x
cn=lead\ space,dc=x
cn=trail\ ,dc=x

# Hex escapes
cn=a\2Cb,dc=x
cn=a\2cb,dc=x

# Hex-encoded (BER) attribute values: RFC 4514 2.4
cn=#41,dc=z
cn=#0441424344,dc=z

# Multi-valued RDN
cn=a+sn=b,dc=x
sn=b+cn=a,dc=x

# Non-ASCII
cn=Ω,dc=unicode
cn=café,dc=unicode

# Empty and degenerate
cn=,dc=x
dc=com

# Unknown attribute type
unknownAttr=value,dc=x

# OID-form attribute type
2.5.4.3=value,dc=x

# Malformed
cn
cn=a,,dc=x
=value,dc=x
cn=a,dc=
